text:
mia (design): quick UX pass on Compliance > Retention: three tiny nits: retention help copy, region fallback wording, and KMS badge labels. dropping a mini-mock in the thread.

raj (engineer): can we keep visible KMS text short? full IDs are noisy. plan: show provider + short alias, tooltip for full ref.

olga (security): required: audit logs must include a non-secret reference (alias or token). truncate UI displays but include reference in logs.

ben (product): badge text proposal: 'Customer-managed KMS' and 'Redwood-managed'. prefer Title Case.

mia (design): ok. help text draft: 'Retention controls how long request and response data is stored. Choose a region to keep data in that jurisdiction. If your region is unavailable, Redwood may temporarily serve from a fallback region; this event will be logged.' link help with aria-describedby.

raj (engineer): toast copy for fallback: 'Serving from us-east-1 (fallback). See Audit Log for details.' add :warning: only when crossing compliance boundary.

log-bot: NOTE: avoid including full ARNs or secret material in logs.

olga (security): audit log example to standardize: '[2026-09-10T12:00:01Z] ben@acme updated retention: 30d -> 90d; intended_region=eu-west-1; served_region=us-east-1; encryption="Customer-managed KMS (alias=acme-prod...)"'

mia (design): I'll update the mock with stronger focus ring on badges and add tooltip pattern. raj, can you wire the log format & truncated alias?

raj (engineer): yes. I'll feature-flag the toast wording for a small rollout.

ben (product): timeline: mock by EOD, PR next week. thanks all :thumbsup:
